To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) Fibonacci bracketing is superior to linear, exponential and geometric bracketing schemes, (b) generalized registration is superior to registration of individual frames and (c) together, Fibonacci bracketing and generalized registration are superior to existing approaches

we have developed a Fibonacci exposure bracketing scheme and a generalized registration scheme that, when used together, produce images with a large dynamic range while minimizing motion-related artifacts.

(1) Fibonacci exposure bracketing is a new exposure bracketing scheme that is robust to motion; (2) generalized registration is a new registration scheme that is robust against exposure differences; and (3) the combination of Fibonacci exposure bracketing and generalized registration is the first exposure bracketing scheme for HDR imaging that is robust to both motion and exposure differences.
